826-4881-6909-8199.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{W} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
826-4881-6909-8199.easyPrerequisites: Amoeboid Changeling does not have summoning sickness.
826-4881-6909-8199.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, causing Carnage to gain all creature types until end of turn.
Cast Brigid's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 4, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 6.

5078-6918-7296-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4247-4446.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
1981-2415-4247-4446.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Relic Vial and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

3147-5226-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Azorius Chancery.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Azorius Chancery from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Lithatog ability
Repeat.

301-4802-7860.description:
Activate Mogg Raider by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Resolve the Mogg Raider ability.
Repeat.

1558-2638-3861-4231-7824.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2638-3861-4231-7824.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Bard.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2933-4013-5798-7730.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

140-586-5147-5258-5618.description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat from step 2

647-1453-2387-3490.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
647-1453-2387-3490.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to Arwen's toughness.
Animation Module triggers. Holding priority, activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to Arwen's toughness.
Repeat from step 3.

372-997-6767.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian by paying {4}{W}.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Abdel Adrian
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, causing Rescue Skiff to return to the battlefield from exile.
When Rescue Skiff enters, it triggers, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 3.

3532-4030-5078-5402.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-4030-5078-5402.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Storm.
Repeat.

1127-3152-5168.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four colors among permanents you control.
1127-3152-5168.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{W}{U}.
Cast Blinking Spirit by paying {3}{W}.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Bloom Tender.
Activate Blinking Spirit by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1127-3152-5168.notes: In order to get infinite mana, you must control a permanent of each color. You can swap steps 1 and 2 if you don't control a white permanent, but will then have to add {3}{W} to start.

2573-3946-6762.notablePrerequisites: Exploration Broodship has three or more charge counters on it.
2573-3946-6762.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

632-2079-3621-4659-5129.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-2079-3621-4659-5129.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

2292-5968-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
2292-5968-5972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

372-673-813.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Planar Incision exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-673-813.description:
Cast Planar Incision by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Scholar of the Ages and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Scholar of the Ages trigger.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages trigger, returning Planar Incision from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Planar Incision.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Scholar of the Ages and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

4499-4893-5420.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Plundering Pirate.
When Plundering Pirate enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1987-2104-2239-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-2104-2239-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Ardent Elementalist.
When Ardent Elementalist and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation during your draw step.
Repeat.

1339-1636-1689-2708.notablePrerequisites: Sigiled Starfish does not have summoning sickness.
1339-1636-1689-2708.description:
Activate Sigiled Starfish by tapping it, causing you to draw a card due to Eligeth.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1202-2034-5003-5542.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Moonvessel dies, it triggers twice and Nim Deathmantle triggers once.
Resolve both Myr Moonvessel triggers, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Myr Moonvessel from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

732-1636-4102-4939.notablePrerequisites:
Psionic Gift attached to Felhide Spiritbinder.
Felhide Spiritbinder does not have summoning sickness.
732-1636-4102-4939.description:
Activate Felhide Spiritbinder by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary by paying {R/G}{R/G}.
When Burning-Tree Emissary enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Burning-Tree Emissary trigger, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Felhide Spiritbinder triggers, holding priority, activate it by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Felhide Spiritbinder trigger, causing you to pay {1}{R} to create a token copy of Burning-Tree Emissary with haste.
Repeat from step 3.

224-578-2043-4754.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three artifact cards in hand.
Metalworker does not have summoning sickness.
224-578-2043-4754.description:
Activate Metalworker by tapping it and revealing at least three artifact cards from your hand, adding at least six {C}.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Razortide Bridge that is a 1/1 Soldier.
When the Razortide Bridge token enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Metalworker.
Repeat.
If you have four or more artifact cards in hand, this combo nets infinite colorless mana, and you may target any artifact you control to get infinite copies of them.

803-2122-4435-4997.notablePrerequisites:
Mindless Automaton has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
"Merfolk" or "Knight" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-2122-4435-4997.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw two cards.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

168-2781-4846.description:
Cast Worldgorger Dragon by paying {3}{R}{R}{R}.
Worldgorger Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling all other permanents you control.
Oblivion Ring leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Felidar Guardian from exile to the battlefield.
Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, blinking Worldgorger Dragon.
Worldgorger leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering its first and second abilities.
Resolve the second Worldgorger Dragon trigger, returning all permanents exiled with it to the battlefield.
Oblivion Ring enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling Felidar Guardian until Oblivion Ring leaves the battlefield.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the first Worldgorger Dragon trigger, exiling all other permanents you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1479-2638-3478.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2638-3478.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it, Tireless Tracker, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Tireless Tracker trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1331-1495-3921.notablePrerequisites:
Scythe of the Wretched attached to Triskelion.
Triskelion has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
1331-1495-3921.description:
If Triskelion has more than 3 +1/+1 counters on it, activate Trislekion by removing all additional counters to deal damage to your choice of targets.
Activate Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it to deal 1 damage to itself.
Repeat step 1 an additional 2 times, killing Triskelion.
Scythe of the Wretched triggers, returning Triskelion to the battlefield with Scythe of the Wretched attached to it.
Repeat.
